title: Final-bit processing
statement: For every bit string $x$, every $f\in\{0,1,2\}$, and every register assignment $v$ bounded by $4(|x|+1)$, the fixed multiplication program, started in the clearing state for field $f$, reaches a configuration with register $0$ set to $v(s_f)-c_f$, where $(s_0,s_1,s_2)=(4,5,1)$ and $(c_0,c_1,c_2)=(2,2,1)$. If the bit of $x$ at that position is $1$ (with out-of-range bits treated as $0$), the resulting state is the next canonical-field test; otherwise it is the rejecting answer state. Every earlier configuration satisfies the program's instruction side conditions and register bound.
